name: Kinabalu Park
description: Kinabalu Park sits on Borneo's northern tip in Sabah, Malaysia, and is crowned by Mount Kinabalu. At 4,095 metres, it is the tallest peak between the Himalayas and New Guinea. Climbers pass from steamy lowland rainforest through mossy mountain forest to bare, windswept heights. Along the way they meet plants from Asia and Australia, and more than 4,500 species of plants and animals live here.
